thread:
Ana: Heads up — Novus Health QBR prep. We got a budget alert overnight, spend spike on embeddings during onboarding. Can we triage? :warning:
Mike: saw it. Alert from budget-sentinel at 03:12 UTC. Their daily burn jumped ~3x vs baseline. Link to spend dashboard: https://console.redwood/clients/novus/spend :eyes:
Sara: onboarding batch ran a large vectorization job — customer said they were ingesting full historical notes. Did they get the recommended pre-tokenization and dedupe guidance?
Ana: not sure. CS notes show they used the default pipeline. We should get them set up on chunking + local prefilter asap. Also flag renewal risk if we don't stabilize.
James: copying the quick mitigation steps I used yesterday on another account:
```
- enable embedding batching (batch_size: 64)
- enable kv-cache for session replays
- apply prefix caching for static prompts
- down-quantize non-critical models (int8)
```
Mike: OpsBot just posted the raw alert: OpsBot: [budget-alert] Novus Health (acct: NOVUS-453) threshold breached: today tokens=1,234,567 (projected monthly=37M). Trigger: embed-heavy-ingestion. Actions: temporary throttle, notify CS, escalate to FinOps.
Ana: Can FinOps team produce a short projection for QBR (token econ slide) by EOD tomorrow? We need 3 scenarios: conservative (apply batching + throttle), median (batching + quant), aggressive (no change).
Mike: I'll run projections. Quick SQL I used to slice spend by route:
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cost) as cost
FROM token_events
WHERE account_id = 'NOVUS-453' AND ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Sara: I'll reach out to Novus PM to schedule a 30m enablement tomorrow — goal: show dedupe + chunking + how to use Redwood Optimize presets. I can also share a one-pager.
Ana: Perfect. Also need one-liner for QBR: "Onboarding ingestion spike; proposed mitigations projected to cut monthly token spend by 40-70% depending on adoption."
James: tagging in a recommended email snippet for the customer:
"Hi team — noticed a high-volume ingestion job is driving unexpected token burn. We recommend batching, pre-tokenization, and enabling the Optimize presets for embeddings. We can run a joint 30-min session to implement and monitor. Recommended temporary throttle is available if you want immediate relief."
Ana: Great. Mike — can you upload the three projection slides to the QBR deck and add a cost alert rule we can flip on that pauses ingestion jobs > X tokens/day?
Mike: On it. I'll add the slides and create a budget alert with a safe throttle (50% of current peak) and tag @Ops on the rule.
OpsBot: [action_created] budget_rule/novus-throttle-179923 created by Mike. Rule: pause ingestion when daily tokens > 2,000,000.
Sara: I'll confirm with Novus after our enablement. If they accept the Optimize presets we can include acceptance in the QBR notes.
Ana: Thanks everyone — small ask: capture any customer feedback during the session for the QBR (what parts of docs were unclear / automation gaps). I'll compile for the renewal risk slide. :thumbsup:
